definitions.gloss: anyhow; anyway; in any case; at any rate
definitions.explanation: Sets aside other considerations to focus on the main point.
Used in the pattern ～はともかく to mean 'leaving ~ aside'.

examples.japanese: ともかく、まず{食|た}べよう。
ともかく{連絡|れんらく}してみたら?
examples.english: Why don't you try contacting them anyway?

examples.japanese: {理由|りゆう}はともかく、ともかく{早|はや}く{来|き}てください。
examples.english: Never mind the reason, just come quickly.

examples.japanese: {難|むずか}しいかもしれないが、ともかくやってみなければ{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: It might be difficult, but you won't know unless you try anyway.

examples.japanese: {値段|ねだん}はともかく、{味|あじ}はいい。
examples.english: Setting aside the price, the taste is good.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}はともかく、{全力|ぜんりょく}を{尽|つ}くした。
examples.english: Leaving the result aside, I gave it my all.

examples.japanese: {見|み}た{目|め}はともかく、{使|つか}いやすさが{大事|だいじ}だ。
examples.english: Appearance aside, ease of use is what matters.

examples.japanese: {好|す}き{嫌|きら}いはともかく、{体|からだ}にいいから{食|た}べなさい。
examples.english: Whether you like it or not aside, eat it because it's good for you.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}はともかく、{健康|けんこう}を{大切|たいせつ}にしてほしい。
examples.english: Work aside, I want you to take care of your health.

notes:
ともかく means "anyhow" or "in any case."

TWO MAIN USES:
1. As a sentence opener - Sets aside previous discussion
2. In ～はともかく pattern - Means "setting ~ aside"

SIMILAR:
・とにかく - anyway, anyhow (more emphatic)
・いずれにせよ - in any case (formal)

NUANCE:
ともかく suggests temporarily setting aside complications to focus on what should be done.
